entries.wording: The item information has been received in the Pošta Slovenije system
entries.note: The sender's data arrived; the detail line says the item is not handed over yet.

entries.wording: The item has arrived at Pošta Slovenije
entries.note: Accepted at the post office or centre the scan names. Inbound items get it when they reach Slovenia.
UPU EMA: the item posted for abroad.
UPU EMB: the item at the outward office of exchange.
UPU EMC: the item leaves the outward office of exchange for abroad.
UPU EMJ: the item at an office of exchange of a country it crosses on its way.
UPU EMK: the item leaves that transit office of exchange.
UPU EMD: the item from abroad at the inward office of exchange.
UPU EMF: the item leaves the inward office of exchange on its way to delivery.
UPU EMG: the item from abroad at the office that delivers it.
UPU EMI: final delivery to the recipient, seen after the inward EMC to EMG events.

entries.wording: The item is expected to be delivered today
entries.note: Seen with the detail line "The item is out for doorstep delivery".

entries.wording: The item is on its way to the selected parcel locker
The item was delivered to the mailbox / P.O. box
entries.note: Seen with the detail line "The item was delivered to the doorstep". After an item was sent back, the adapter reads it as returned.
The Slovenian wording is more exact: nobody collected the item from the parcel locker in time.
Not collected. The next step follows, such as "The item is ready for pickup at the post office".

entries.wording: Unsuccessful delivery attempt. Item is being returned to the sender
entries.note: Not collected and sent back to the sender. A delivery after it reaches the sender.
Could not be delivered; seen with the next step "The item will be redirected to the post office".

entries.wording: The item is ready for pickup at the post office
entries.note: Its place names the post office the item waits at.

entries.wording: The item is ready for pickup at the post office
entries.note: Its place names the post office the item waits at, after a failed delivery.
